title: Virtual Compute: assisted review operation
content:
## Use and effect

Virtual Compute — Record an accountant arithmetic review for one primary invoice line against its provider export. The review records the corrected pretax amount and an incorrect decision; a successful receipt identifies the official completed review without moving money.

## Invocation

review_compute_line_e30849b6 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter compute_holding_id

`compute_holding_id`: Id class — The compute contract reference for assisted review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter customer_id

`customer_id`: Id class — The customer profile reference for assisted review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter compute_event_id

`compute_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the source-correlated evidence packet returned by find_compute_events: the compute service record with source subtype review, source_event_id equal to the original primary charge, and related_event_id equal to that charge's provider export reference.

## Parameter source_event_id

`source_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the original invoice line or payment being handled, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter related_event_id

`related_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the related export or approved review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter net_amount

`net_amount`: Fixed-format class — The corrected pretax amount in units of USD to two decimals, supplied as a decimal number already rounded half-up to two decimal places at calculation completion; stored to two decimals, with no empty value.

## Successful receipt

The successful string receipt identifies the newly recorded assisted review by its new business event reference and confirms its approved registration and the business effect described above.
